name: coldtrail-e2e
description: End-to-end Playwright suite for coldtrail's browser UI. Every spec drives a real `coldtrail serve` started by harness/server.mjs in a throwaway COLDTRAIL_HOME with sending, OS timers and self-update switched off and fake agent CLIs first on PATH (`opencode` answers with canned turns, `claude` and `codex` refuse); routes that would open Chrome, OAuth or LinkedIn are intercepted in the page. Nothing here may touch ~/.coldtrail, real secrets, LaunchAgents, Gmail, Canonical, LinkedIn or a model.
